notes.title: Space Farmers Update 1.5 - Attack of the Vegtabots!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.bumpkinbrothers.com/images/vegtabots.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Vegtabots Have Arrived![/h1]

The Attack of the Vegtabots update is here.  We all knew vegetables were bad for us and now we know why!  Play the new single player mini-game and see how long you can survive against a horde of cybernetic vegetables.  

Plus play the horrifyingly hard new multiplayer level. We've taken one of your favourite levels and turned up the difficulty to 11.

Happy Halloween.
[list]
[*] A new single player minigame
[*] 4 new characters
[*] Spooky new accessories
[*] 2 new achievements
[*] a new multiplayer level
[/list]

notes.title: Attack of the Vegtabots
notes.content:
[img]http://www.bumpkinbrothers.com/images/aotv.jpg[/img]

This Halloween prepare to hide behind your sofa because thing are getting spooky in a BRAND NEW GAME MODE.  
[list]
[*]SURVIVAL MODE - pits you against hordes of new enemies. How long will you last?
[*]WAITING FOR BACKUP? – survival mode will be playable as single player!
[*]VEGTABOTS – new enemies, hideous cyborg veg from beyond the compost.
[*]NEW CHARACTERS - Spooky new skins you can use in the main game.
[/list]
Can you stand the terror!  Attack of the Vegtabots will be creeping into your copy of Space Farmers this Halloween as a free update.

notes.title: Space Farmers 1.4 Update!
notes.content:
A big hello to all the new and existing players of Space Farmers!

We're proud to announce a huge update to the game featuring the following:

5 New Levels:
 - Rocket (can you survive on the rocket?)
 - Spin and Shoot (Meet SpinnyMcShooty!)
 - The Dropper (Be good to your friends)
 - SwapShop (Some animals go elsewhere)
 - Big Mama (She's not happy with what you've been up to!)

Also we have some new characters:
 - Anna Sassin (she's very mysterious)
 - Grok (he also has his own helmet)
 - The Swine (He's a right pig)
 - ??????? (a mystery character with a pink moustache?!)

Finally there are a few fixes:
 - Fixed Explorer achievement (but you will need to pick up the funny face mask again)
 - Volume sliders added to main menu
 - Pitchfork hit issue (sometimes didn't register for statistics)
 - Party Blower Audio (they now play all the sounds!)
 - Attempted fix for "One-Upmanship" and "Surivivors" achievements (I was not able to replicate these so I've taken a shot at a fix for those having problems)
- Fix for Character "reselection" bug where you could break the game by selecting a different character after clicking on Ready. (This created duplicate characters in the game)

That's about it. I hope you enjoy the new additions. It's great to see so many people enjoying the game and we're loving the feedback that we've been getting so keep it up!

Don't forget that Space Farmers is currently in the Titanium Bundle on bundle stars with some great other games: http://www.bundlestars.com/all-bundles/titanium-bundle/

notes.title: Split Screen Update! (version 1.3)
notes.content:
Split Screen Mode is now available for Space Farmers!

Now you can pick up pigs and swing your pitchfork with a friend on the same machine.

We promised it would arrive and now it's here! Play with either Mouse/Keyboard & controller or with two controllers on PC, Mac or Linux.

Thanks for your patience everyone while we got this update sorted. There were a number of development road bumps for us with this which we'll be talking about soon (it's a whole article's worth).

We took this version with us to the Radius Festival in London last weekend and the feedback was awesome. So we know that anyone who has been waiting for this is going to love it.

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

notes.title: New levels, new gadgets, new characters and HATS + more!
notes.content:
Hi all and thanks for keeping up to date with Space Farmers developments. 

This is an announcement for version 1.2 of the game.

New Features:
 - 5 New levels
 - 2 New hidden hats
 - 2 New Characters
 - Level Select Screen Update

First off lets talk about the two new characters. These are Patch and Betty-Sue, from Lara and Stephanie our "Design a Character" contest winners. Patch is an awesome scarecrow while Betty-Sue is a cute doll, make sure you play with them both!

Next up are the new levels. We've included 5 whole new levels with new puzzles and challenges for you all. We'd love to hear what you think of them so let us know.

We've also included the long awaited Level Select screen update where you can now select the levels you play (once you've completed 10 levels). 

Also there are now two new hats. The first is in one of the new levels and is given to you if you complete a final puzzle. The second is in an existing level and is very well hidden. See if you can find it!

Thank you to everyone for your support, we really appreciate it.

-Andy & Rich
